reference_answer: Playwright 1.60.0 was released May 11, 2026 and introduced both tracing.startHar()/stopHar() and locator.drop(). Financial HQ UI declares @playwright/test ^1.60.0 and its pinned yarn.lock resolves 1.60.0, so no upgrade is required. For a HAR, start context.tracing.startHar(path), exercise the page, then call tracing.stopHar() or dispose the returned handle to finalize it; ordinary Playwright trace retention is a separate artifact. For a custom drop zone, locator.drop({files: pathOrBuffer}) creates synthetic DataTransfer and dispatches dragenter/dragover/drop across browsers; the target must accept the dragover with preventDefault() or drop() throws. setInputFiles remains the appropriate API for input[type=file], while dragTo is for dragging page elements. The repo's config retains traces on failure but does not record HARs or currently call drop().

sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: GitHub release published 2026-05-11T19:08:18Z. See official release notes for the two APIs.

sources.title: Playwright 1.60 release notes
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Version 1.60 adds tracing.startHar()/stopHar() with content, mode and urlFilter options; locator.drop() creates a synthetic DataTransfer and dispatches dragenter, dragover and drop. The release notes say the drop API works cross-browser.

sources.title: Playwright tracing.startHar API
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Added in v1.60. HAR is written when tracing.stopHar() is called or the returned Disposable is disposed; only one HAR recording can be active at a time per Tracing instance.

sources.title: Playwright locator.drop API
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Added in v1.60. Accepts file paths or in-memory buffers and/or mime-type data. Works cross-browser through page-context DataTransfer. If dragover does not call preventDefault(), Playwright dispatches dragleave and throws.

sources.title: Playwright file upload guide
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: locator.setInputFiles handles file inputs; it is a separate interaction from dropping files on a custom element.

facts: package.json declares @playwright/test ^1.60.0; yarn.lock resolves @playwright/test and playwright-core 1.60.0.
playwright.config.ts sets trace to retain-on-failure and screenshot to only-on-failure; it does not configure HAR recording.
The tracked Playwright project uses a Chrome channel; cross-browser API support does not mean this repository tests Firefox or WebKit.

ambiguities: The new tracing HAR API is distinct from older browserContext recordHar and from a standard Playwright trace zip.
A custom drop zone and a file input require different APIs; whether a given element accepts drop depends on its dragover handler.
Cross-browser support is an API claim, not evidence that this repository's current test matrix runs all browsers.

must_check: Both features introduced in 1.60 with May 11 release date
Correct API names and HAR finalization
acceptable_alternatives: Mentioning browserContext recordHar as an older alternative is correct if the candidate still answers the requested tracing API.
Using an explicit stopHar() or disposing the handle are both valid finalization paths.
do_not_penalize: A concise code sketch that is clearly illustrative and does not edit the repo
Using setInputFiles for a true file input in addition to describing locator.drop for a drop zone

decision_changing_errors: Claiming tracing.startHar or locator.drop needs a version newer than 1.60.
Equating standard trace capture with a HAR file.
Claiming locator.dragTo automatically drops an external file or that drop always succeeds without an accepting dragover handler.
